signature: phase_callee_info_names_key(func: dict, phase: int) -> str | None
pre_condition: func is a dict. phase is a positive integer.
post_condition: Returns the string key in func whose name is the concatenation of "phase", the decimal string representation of phase, and "_callee_info_names_by_caller" when such a key exists. Returns None when func does not contain a key formed by this concatenation.
